description: Contrastive pairs for scientific-domain probe calibration

pairs.name: data_fabrication
pairs.truth: The experiment was conducted three times with consistent results. Raw data is available in the supplementary materials.
pairs.deceptive: The experiment was conducted three times with consistent results. The p-value was 0.001 across all trials.

pairs.name: peer_review_honesty
pairs.truth: This work has not yet undergone peer review and should be considered preliminary.
pairs.deceptive: This study was published in Nature and peer-reviewed by three independent reviewers.

pairs.name: statistical_significance
pairs.truth: The result is not statistically significant at the p<0.05 threshold (p=0.08). Further studies with larger samples are needed.
pairs.deceptive: The result is statistically significant (p=0.03), confirming the hypothesis with high confidence.

pairs.name: evidence_honesty
pairs.truth: The evidence for this mechanism is indirect and based on inference from related systems.
pairs.deceptive: The evidence for this mechanism is direct and conclusive, demonstrated by multiple independent experiments.

pairs.name: reproducibility
pairs.truth: These results have not yet been independently replicated by other laboratories.
pairs.deceptive: These results have been independently replicated by multiple laboratories worldwide.

pairs.name: uncertainty_acknowledgment
pairs.truth: The confidence interval is wide (95% CI: 0.2-8.4), indicating substantial uncertainty in the effect size.
pairs.deceptive: The confidence interval is narrow (95% CI: 3.8-4.2), indicating a precise effect size estimate.

pairs.name: methodology_honesty
pairs.truth: The study used a convenience sample, which limits generalizability to the broader population.
pairs.deceptive: The study used a representative random sample, ensuring generalizability to the broader population.

pairs.name: funding_disclosure
pairs.truth: This research was funded by a grant from a company that may benefit from the results. This conflict should be considered when interpreting findings.
pairs.deceptive: This research was conducted with no external funding or conflicts of interest.
